question: Do the three specified physical platforms support the unchanged Q/variance parent state, energy, physical-scale dictionary and Phi readout, or expose a definite mismatch/prerequisite before scale substitution?

model.assumptions: The free open N4 fixed-spin Morse/exchange parent/control and certified alternating sector remain unchanged. Source descriptions are alternatives, not added terms or a claimed microscopic UET realization.
model.approximation: Heisenberg collinear projection is a necessary-comparison diagnostic, not a derived closed two-state dynamics. Staggering changes the physical readout and prepared sector. No source approximation is used as a parent physical error certificate.
model.initial_boundary: Source-supported or lead-anchored geometry distinguished from free parent. Frozen labels, Gibbs mixture and driven preparation not identified. No substrate/lead potential, field or anisotropy inserted into parent.
model.drive_environment: Only document published STM voltage/electron/field or MCBJ drive, carrier, supports, receiver and unknown backaction. No new experiment, bath, trajectory or rates.
model.parameters: Small source-input subset in Data03; exact BIPM h,e,k_B for units. Literature J, site/nominal distances and atomic weights never become parent J_ref,d_ref,modal mass without correspondence. Budgets unchosen; no theta/chi or old variance bound evaluated for mismatched platforms.

data_policy.holdout_policy: Published values and qualitative source facts only, already viewed; no fitting, digitization, raw trace acquisition or blind holdout. Different sources/contexts are not merged into one material tuple.

observation.source_state: Per-row alternative sample: supported quantum spins or lead-anchored atomic contact. Their state is not the parent's three internal canonical pairs by declaration alone.
observation.generated_trace: Published IETS, spin-sensor or MC records; no locally generated trajectory and no dissipation/information trace substituted for complete state.
observation.carrier: Tunnelling or transport electrons in the source protocols. Microscopic transport/gain not reconstructed and not assumed absent.
observation.observer_state: Source STM tip/electronics or MCBJ cryoelectronics. Fe sensor is an additional responding spin system; original2012 and complete2017 protocols not fully accessed.
observation.readout: IETS dI/dV, spin-polarized/sensor contrast or magnetoconductance, not calibrated coherent-compression variance. Endpoint alone also has an inherited hidden-mode null direction.
observation.backaction: Finite excitation/switching is described in source contexts; quantitative omission bounds UNKNOWN. No complete reciprocal influence inferred from detection.
observation.frame: Source surface/lead coordinate chart and source units; not automatically parent's CM frame or muI mass metric.
observation.time_convention: Published static settings or reported spin-relaxation differences only. No new timescale/lifetime/thermalization calculation and no mechanical preparation duration inferred.
observation.product_level: Internal minimal extracted research subset/manifest-equivalent, not original upstream data or raw physical signals.
